queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'NVM for Windows' AND publisher = 'Author Software Inc.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'NVM for Windows' AND publisher = 'Author Software Inc.' AND version_compare(version, '2.0.1') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'nvm for windows.exe');
